rationale: Exact-source scoped review of main9c832234 after #22410 supersedes the prior reviewed workspace991e06f6; the historical authority and consumer pins remain unchanged. SPEC_CORRESPONDENCE.md maps all amended clauses to the selected historical consumers. The registry initialization tail, stock Comet vote/sign-bytes/FilePV/handler rules, selected Registry lifecycle and ordinary L1 checkpoint save/get behavior remain within the historical bounded scope. This does not validate the new SignalService deployment, L1 Unzen checkpoint forwarding/cutoff, L2 EIP-4788 root lookup/store closure, implementation proof at S, or the additional beaconRootsFrom-versus-local-fork-time check at every trust target. Abstract trusted-state premises and mocked Registry snapshot/generation inputs do not establish those checks. This is neither editorial nor whole-SPEC equivalence, does not cover future bytes, and cannot make historical native results evidence of the amended paths.
